results.title: Trump approval rating: Latest polls show new lows in 2026

results.content:
Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. results.title: Map Shows Trump’s Approval Rating in Every State 3 Months Until Midterms

results.content: Florida, a state Trump carried by more than 13 points, now sits at -12 (42 percent approve, 54 percent disapprove). Texas has fallen to -13 (40 percent approve, 54 percent disapprove), and Ohio matches that exact score. Alaska and Iowa post the lowest readings of the group, both at -14. South Carolina comes in at -9, Missouri at -7, Louisiana at -4, Kentucky and Nebraska both at -3, and Mississippi is just barely negative at -1.
